build_transformer: build a DETR Transformer model from argparse args with encoder and decoder layers
create_transformer_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder with cloned encoder layers and optional layer normalization
create_transformer_decoder: create a TransformerDecoder with cloned decoder layers and intermediate output support
run_transformer_forward: run the Transformer forward pass on 5D source tensors with positional embeddings and query embeddings
clone_module: clone a PyTorch module N times using deepcopy into an nn.ModuleList
